verdict.rationale: Veriff documents creating a session via POST /v1/sessions and polling GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision for status and results. It also provides a public API for teams building their own front-end, plus a Postman collection. The pack has no evidence of endpoints for retrieving captured media or for cancelling or redacting a session, so only about half the lifecycle is shown as API-drivable. missing for 10: documented media-retrieval endpoint, cancel/redact (deletion) endpoint, proof that every lifecycle step is documented, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the whole verification lifecycle is drivable through the API — create a session, get its status, retrieve results and captured media, and cancel or redact it — with every step documented

citations.quote: Use this endpoint to **initiate a new verification session** for an end-user. Every verification flow begins with creating a session.
